education.design: Student mathematics tutoring with owned problem context, verified tools and evidence-driven learning
education.core_source: Education Python service adapted from QingQi experiments and versioned in this repository
education.interaction: Web only; education CLI/plugin/external MCP retired
education.practice_scope: Current local math_student index: 3097 math graph nodes, 71 initialized profile topics; 189 eligible source items + 96 labeled rule variants = 285 candidates, 268 student-ready grade-7 items. Counts are snapshot statistics, not calibrated mastery or complete textbook coverage.
education.initial_seed_scope: Historical numeric_seed_v1 acceptance fixture: 5 math topics and 45 seed items; not the current production dataset.
education.model_adaptation: Based on ZCode ModelProviderSectionLayout, ProviderCardHeader/ConnectionSection/ApiKeySection, ModelRowInput, ProviderModelMetadataDialog and draft validators through the public UI export; Store owns provider connections, nested models and concrete role selections.
education.model_state_owner: Same Store SQLite; per-deployment-scope versioned provider/role settings; encrypted local credentials; frozen per-turn JSONModel clients
education.architecture: source_architecture_v11; one system relationship diagram, explicit decide-call-observe cycle, sixteen source-bound module scopes
education.zcode_foundation: Tool execution/scheduling, skill/MCP adapters, controlled foreground subagent lifecycle and recall filtering; Python owns education state; full AgentRuntime and automatic extraction/dream are not integrated

curriculum.prerequisite_status: title aligned candidates, not expert confirmed
curriculum.distribution: Local data, not uploaded or committed
curriculum.scope: Legacy all-subject curriculum import snapshot; not the current 3097-node student math graph.

models.glm: Configurable text tutor; high reasoning by default, low selectable in composer
models.difficulty8b: selected original full SFT base plus teaching LoRA, no rebased substitution
models.review27b: Qwen3.5-27B plus expanded review LoRA, original step IDs converted and independently checked
models.selection: User-configurable text/vision split or shared multimodal model; original 8B/27B specialist deployments retained
